title: Glow-Beetle Hollows
theme: A tiny lantern-backed beetle threads mossy root hollows, gathering fallen glow-seeds to wake the burrow doors.
mechanics: Move one cell at a time through a hand-authored maze
Collect every glow-seed in the hollow
The burrow door stays sealed until all seeds are gathered
Bumping walls gives a small physical nudge feedback
Four hand-authored hollows of rising size and seed count
Move counter tracked per hollow and across the whole run

controls.action: Move by swiping or tapping a neighbourin
